contract.intent: Read access to any journey through the SAME commands: an ANN_STORE location (empty = the active session) points the store at an archived session or another journey, same store shape but a different folder, so archived journeys are readable read-only via the ordinary commands.
acceptanceCriteria: ANN_STORE (env; empty/unset = the active session) names the journey to read: a project root with .ann/journey, or an archived session bare journey dir (the shape goal! archive writes); the same read commands (status, journey, detail, branch, results, next, ledger, verify, goal) work against it
Store and root resolution normalize both shapes to a journey root; a bad or absent target fails CLOSED with a named error, never a silent empty tree

Doc and spec reads resolve manifest-forward only under a project root with a docs home; under an archived journey root they resolve through the legacy current() over the target nodes, with recorded artifact paths remapped into the target store

Targets other than the active session are READ-ONLY: journey writes (append!, spawn!, submit!, gate!, goal!, run!, docs --write) refuse with a named error; --project/ANN_PROJECT are unchanged (project identity vs snapshot selection); docs stays project-scoped
The archived v1 session is readable end-to-end via ANN_STORE; the suite is green; ann check and verify are clean on the live journey; recorded with evidence plus gate rationale
